mergedParams.userDescription: Bouncy, bubble letters with bright, popping colors and elastic motion. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Bouncy Bubble Letters with Bright Colors & Elastic Motion

prompts.prompt: Create a vibrant, physics-based bubble letter preset that mimics inflatable balloon letters popping into view. Each word should appear as if air is being pumped into flat text, inflating it to become 3D-like bubble letters with a glossy finish. The animation should use a multi-stage sequence: first the text appears flat and small, then expands with an elastic overshoot (scale from 0.1 to 1.15 then settle to 1.0), while simultaneously applying a color transition from a muted pastel to a bright, saturated neon gradient. Add subtle wobble animations that continue throughout the duration, suggesting the letters are filled with helium. Each letter should have a slight delay creating a wave effect across the word. Include a shiny highlight that moves across each letter like light reflecting off a balloon surface.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use TextAtom components wrapped in BaseLayout containers with 'relative overflow-visible' classes. Structure each word as its own BaseLayout with 'inline-flex items-baseline' for proper alignment. Apply a three-stage effect array: initial scale effect (0-300ms, scale from 0.1 to 1.15 with spring easing), settle effect (300-500ms, scale from 1.15 to 1.0 with ease-out), and continuous wobble (500ms-end, subtle translateY and rotate oscillation). Use 'text-6xl font-black' as base classes with custom style props for text-shadow creating the bubble depth. Implement gradient backgrounds using 'bg-gradient-to-br from-pink-400 via-purple-500 to-indigo-600 bg-clip-text text-transparent'. Add a pseudo-element for the highlight effect using an absolutely positioned div with 'absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white to-transparent opacity-30' that animates translateX from -100% to 100%. Consider using internal effect presets for the bounce-in and wobble animations. Set letter-spacing to 0.05em for better bubble separation.

prompts.prompt: Design a liquid-morphing bubble text preset where letters appear to be made of colorful soap bubbles that merge and separate dynamically. The text should start as individual circular bubbles scattered across the screen, then magnetically attract to form readable letters while maintaining their bubble-like properties. Use iridescent colors that shift through rainbow hues, with each bubble having its own color cycle offset. The formation animation should feel organic - bubbles should accelerate as they get closer to their target positions, with some overshooting and bouncing back. Once formed, the letters should have a gentle breathing animation where they expand and contract slightly, with occasional small bubbles breaking off and floating upward before disappearing.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Implement using multiple nested BaseLayout containers: outer container with 'relative w-full h-full', word containers with 'absolute' positioning calculated from caption data word positions. Each letter should be a separate TextAtom wrapped in its own BaseLayout with 'absolute' positioning and initial random transform values. Use a complex effects array: position interpolation (0-1500ms, translateX/Y from random values to final positions with custom spring easing), scale breathing (1500ms-end, scale oscillating between 0.95 and 1.05), and hue rotation (continuous, filter: hue-rotate animating 0-360deg). Apply 'rounded-full' to create circular bubble shapes initially, transitioning to 'rounded-3xl' as they form letters. Use CSS filters for the iridescent effect: 'filter: hue-rotate(var(--hue)) saturate(1.5) brightness(1.2)'. Create floating bubble particles using additional ShapeAtom components with 'absolute bottom-0 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-gradient-radial' that animate upward with opacity fade. Consider using sub-presets for particle generation and management.

prompts.prompt: Build a retro arcade-style bouncy text preset inspired by 80s video game aesthetics. Letters should bounce in from the top of the screen one by one, with exaggerated squash-and-stretch deformation on impact. Each bounce should trigger a bright neon color flash and pixel-burst particle effect. The text should have a chunky, pixelated appearance with bold outlines and inner glow effects. After the initial bounce sequence, maintain subtle idle animations where letters randomly do small hops, creating a playful, energetic feel. Include scanline effects and chromatic aberration for authentic retro vibes. Sound-reactive elements could make the text pulse with bass frequencies if audio is present.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout using 'flex flex-wrap gap-2 items-end justify-center'. Each letter as TextAtom in BaseLayout wrapper with 'relative' positioning. Implement bounce physics using keyframe effects: drop phase (0-400ms, translateY from -200% to 0, scaleY from 1 to 0.6 on impact), bounce-back (400-600ms, scaleY from 0.6 to 1.3), settle (600-800ms, scaleY from 1.3 to 1). Apply 'font-mono text-7xl font-black' with custom CSS for pixelated look using image-rendering: pixelated on a scaled-down then scaled-up render. Create multi-layer text effects: base text with 'text-cyan-400', duplicate layers for outline using 'absolute inset-0 text-stroke-4 text-stroke-black', and glow using 'absolute inset-0 blur-md text-yellow-300 opacity-70'. Add scanlines using a repeating linear gradient overlay. Implement particle bursts using multiple ShapeAtom components with 'absolute w-1 h-1 bg-white' that explode outward using transform effects. If audio data is available, use waveform effects to modulate scale based on bass frequencies with sensitivity 0.3 and threshold 0.5.

prompts.prompt: Create a playful jelly-text preset where letters behave like colorful gelatin desserts. Text should jiggle and bounce with realistic physics - when one letter moves, it should cause ripple effects through adjacent letters like they're connected by invisible springs. Initial appearance should be a dramatic 'splat' effect where letters drop and deform significantly before wobbling back to shape. Colors should be translucent and candy-like with glossy highlights. Include a continuous subtle jiggle that responds to 'impacts' - either from new text appearing or from beat detection in background audio. The elasticity should feel satisfying and hypnotic, with longer words creating more complex wave patterns through the connected letters.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'inline-flex items-center' for word grouping. Implement spring physics simulation using custom effect calculations in presetExecution. Each TextAtom should have 'relative' positioning with initial transform-origin set to 'bottom center'. Apply multiple overlapping effects: primary deformation (0-1000ms, scaleX/Y with values calculated based on spring physics), rotation wobble (0-1500ms, rotate between -15deg and 15deg with spring easing), and continuous micro-movements (1500ms-end, small random translateX/Y perturbations). Style with 'text-8xl font-black' and semi-transparent colors using 'text-opacity-80'. Create jelly appearance using multiple text-shadows: 'text-shadow: 0 0 20px currentColor, 0 0 40px currentColor, 2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)'. Add glossy highlight using absolute positioned div with 'bg-gradient-to-b from-white to-transparent opacity-40 rounded-t-full'. For connected physics, calculate each letter's position based on previous letter's animation state, creating a propagating wave effect. Use fitDurationTo: 'children' to ensure animations complete properly.

prompts.prompt: Develop a soap bubble typography preset where each word appears inside its own transparent, iridescent bubble that floats and drifts naturally. The bubbles should have realistic properties - they shimmer with rainbow colors, reflect their environment, and occasionally merge when they collide. Text within bubbles should be slightly distorted as if viewed through curved glass. Bubbles enter from random positions, floating toward their final layout positions while rotating slowly. The entire composition should feel weightless and dreamlike. Include subtle wind effects that cause all bubbles to drift in synchronized patterns. When bubbles pop (at the end of their duration), they should burst into smaller bubbles that float away.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Create complex nested structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden', individual bubble containers with 'absolute' positioning. Each bubble is a BaseLayout with 'relative rounded-full overflow-hidden' containing the TextAtom. Apply backdrop-filter for glass effect: 'backdrop-blur-sm backdrop-brightness-110'. Create iridescent bubble surface using multiple gradient layers: base gradient with 'bg-gradient-conic from-pink-200 via-blue-200 to-pink-200 opacity-30', animated gradient overlay using transform rotate for shimmer effect. Implement floating motion using compound effects: translateX with sine wave pattern, translateY with slower upward drift, gentle rotation. Text distortion using 'transform: perspective(500px) rotateX(5deg)' with slight scaling. Add bubble physics for collision detection in presetExecution - when bubbles overlap, apply temporary scale and position adjustments. Create pop effect using scale to 1.2 with opacity to 0, spawning 3-5 smaller ShapeAtom bubbles with 'rounded-full bg-gradient-radial from-white to-transparent opacity-60'. Use internal effect presets for consistent float patterns across all bubbles.

prompts.prompt: Design an explosive popcorn-style text animation where letters burst onto screen like kernels popping. Each letter should start as a small, compressed shape that suddenly expands with explosive force, overshooting its target size before settling. The popping should happen in rapid succession with random timing variations, creating a chaotic but delightful effect. Colors should transition from a golden yellow (unpopped) to bright white with colorful shadows (popped). Include secondary animations like small letter fragments flying off during the pop, steam effects, and a subtle butter-melt gradient overlay. The settled text should continue to have small random 'pops' where individual letters briefly expand and contract.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure using BaseLayout with 'relative flex flex-wrap gap-1 items-center justify-center p-4'. Each letter wrapped in BaseLayout with 'relative inline-block' for independent animations. Implement pop sequence: compressed state (scale: 0.2, rotate: random(-180, 180)), explosion phase (0-200ms, scale to 1.5, rotate to 0), settle phase (200-400ms, scale to 1.0 with bounce easing). Use staggered delays calculated as 'index * 50 + random(-20, 20)ms' for organic timing. Style progression from 'text-yellow-600' to 'text-white' using color property animation. Add multiple text-shadows for depth: '4px 4px 0 #ff6b6b, 8px 8px 0 #4ecdc4, 12px 12px 0 #45b7d1'. Create fragment particles using ShapeAtom components with 'absolute w-2 h-2 bg-white rounded-sm' that fly outward with rotation. Steam effect using multiple divs with 'absolute bottom-0 w-full h-32 bg-gradient-to-t from-white to-transparent opacity-20' animating upward with blur increase. Random continuing pops using setTimeout in presetExecution to trigger scale pulses on random letters every 500-2000ms.

prompts.prompt: Create a stretchy, elastic gum-bubble text effect where letters appear to be blown up like bubblegum bubbles. The animation should show letters starting as a small point, then stretching outward in all directions unevenly (like gum being blown), becoming increasingly transparent at the edges before snapping into their final bold, rounded shape. The stretch should be asymmetric and organic. Colors should be bright bubblegum pink and blue gradients with a glossy, wet-look finish. After formation, letters should have a subtle sticky quality where they seem to pull slightly when transitioning or moving, like they're made of stretchy material.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'relative inline-flex items-center gap-0' to keep letters connected. Each TextAtom wrapped in container with 'relative' positioning and overflow-visible for stretch effects. Implement stretch animation using combination of scale and skew transforms: initial point (scale: 0.1), stretch phase (0-600ms, scaleX to 1.3, scaleY to 0.8, skewX random(-10, 10)), snap-back (600-800ms, remove skew, scale to 1.0 with spring easing). Apply 'font-black text-8xl' with custom border-radius using clipPath for organic bubble shapes. Create gradient effect with 'bg-gradient-to-br from-pink-400 to-blue-400 bg-clip-text text-transparent'. Add glossy finish using pseudo-element: 'before:absolute before:inset-0 before:bg-gradient-to-t before:from-transparent before:via-white before:to-transparent before:opacity-50 before:translate-y-1/2'. Implement sticky transitions by adding small delay and elastic easing to all transform changes. Use filter: 'drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.3))' for depth. Consider using SVG filters for more complex gum-stretch distortions if needed.

prompts.prompt: Develop a musical bounce-house text preset where letters jump and flip like kids on trampolines. Each letter should have its own rhythm - some doing single bounces, others doing flips, and occasionally synchronized group bounces. The bounces should feel gravity-based with proper acceleration and deceleration. Colors should be bright and festive, cycling through rainbow hues on each bounce. Include shadow effects that stretch and compress based on letter height. Background particles should burst upward on heavy landings. If audio is present, sync major bounces to beat detection. The overall feel should be chaotic joy with underlying rhythmic patterns.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Create BaseLayout stage with 'relative w-full h-full flex items-end justify-center gap-2 pb-8'. Each letter in BaseLayout wrapper with 'relative inline-block transform-gpu will-change-transform'. Implement physics-based bounce using parabolic motion calculations: upward phase with decreasing velocity, apex pause, downward acceleration. Basic bounce effect (0-1000ms loop): translateY from 0 to -100px to 0, with easing that simulates gravity. Add rotation for flips: certain letters (based on index % 3) include rotateX or rotateZ 360deg during jump. Create shadow using absolutely positioned div: 'absolute -bottom-2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-full h-2 bg-black/30 blur-sm' with scaleX based on letter height. Style with 'text-7xl font-black' and hue-rotate animation cycling 0-360deg over 2000ms. Particle effects using ShapeAtom with 'absolute w-1 h-1 rounded-full' spawning at land positions. If audio data exists, use waveform effects with beat detection to trigger synchronized group jumps where all letters perform high bounce simultaneously. Add squash effect on landing: scaleY to 0.8 for 100ms before returning to 1.0.

prompts.prompt: Design a inflatable pool-float text effect where letters appear as glossy, air-filled vinyl pool toys bobbing on invisible water. Each letter should inflate rapidly with visible air pressure, developing realistic highlights and reflections. The bobbing motion should simulate gentle waves - rising and falling with slight tilts and rotations. Colors should be bright summer pastels with transparent qualities. Include water ripple effects beneath each letter and occasional water droplet particles. The inflation sequence should show wrinkles smoothing out as pressure builds. Letters should bump into each other softly, creating realistic collision responses with gentle bounces.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout using 'relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center gap-3'. Each letter container with 'relative inline-block transform-style-preserve-3d'. Implement inflation: start with scaleY: 0.3 and multiple wrinkle shadows, animate to scaleY: 1.0 while reducing shadow complexity. Bobbing motion using compound sine waves: translateY with sin(time * 0.001) * 10px, rotateZ with sin(time * 0.0007) * 3deg, rotateX with sin(time * 0.0013) * 5deg for natural water movement. Apply 'text-8xl font-black' with vinyl appearance using multiple layers: base with 'text-cyan-300', highlight overlay with 'bg-gradient-to-t from-transparent via-white to-transparent opacity-60'. Create inflatable look using text-shadow: '0 0 30px rgba(0,255,255,0.5)' and filter: 'drop-shadow(0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2))'. Water ripples using elliptical ShapeAtom beneath each letter with 'absolute -bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-20 h-4 border-2 border-blue-400/30' animating scale and opacity. Collision detection in presetExecution: when letters overlap, apply temporary opposing translateX forces. Add specular highlights using small absolute positioned divs with 'w-2 h-2 bg-white rounded-full blur-sm'.

prompts.prompt: Create a kinetic graffiti-bubble text preset inspired by street art bubble letters. Text should spray-paint itself into existence with overspray effects, drips, and paint splatters. The letters should have thick, overlapping outlines in contrasting colors with gradient fills. Animation should mimic the arm movements of a graffiti artist - sweeping motions that build up the letters in layers. Include paint drip animations on random letters, spray can shake effects before painting begins, and particle clouds that dissipate. The final result should pulse with urban energy, with subtle size variations and color shifts that make the text feel alive and fresh off the wall.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'relative inline-flex items-center -space-x-4' for overlapping bubble letters. Structure each letter with multiple layers: outline (TextAtom with stroke), fill (TextAtom with gradient), highlights (additional TextAtom). Implement spray-paint reveal using clipPath animation: 'clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0)' to 'inset(0 0 0 0)' with irregular steps to simulate spray pattern. Base styling: 'text-9xl font-black uppercase'. Outline using '-webkit-text-stroke: 8px #000' on bottom layer, fill using 'bg-gradient-to-b from-yellow-400 via-orange-500 to-red-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent' on middle layer. Paint drips using absolutely positioned divs: 'absolute top-full w-1 bg-current' with height animating from 0 to random(20, 60)px. Spray particles using multiple ShapeAtom components with 'absolute w-0.5 h-0.5 rounded-full' in various colors, animating outward with opacity fade. Can shake effect: rapid translateX alternating ±2px for 200ms before paint. Add subtle continuous effects: scale breathing 0.98-1.02, slight hue-rotate animation. Use transform-origin: 'center bottom' for grounded feel. Consider audio-reactive scale pulses if music is present.
